name: messages.observe
caller: host event broker to authorized plugin subscription
payload: message content blocks aligned to MCP ContentBlock (text/image subset); exact field boundary tracks community v0.15 §9 Q3
delivery: at-most-once within a live subscription; no replay guarantee
ordering: sequence is monotonic within scope; gaps are allowed
concurrency: callbacks for one subscription are delivered serially; subscriptions may run concurrently
timeout: host-defined callback budget; timeout closes or skips according to declared host policy
cleanup: subscription is released on deactivate, disconnect, grant revocation, or runtime generation disposal
retention: host MUST NOT persist payload through this contract by default
